patthana16.95:4.1: dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo . . . sahajāta- . . . upanissaya- . . . paccayo . . . (evaṃ nava pi tīsu padesu parivattetabbā). Nahetuyā nava, nārammaṇe nava, no-avigate nava. Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe namagge tīṇi, tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, na-upanissaye tīṇi, novigate tīṇi. Nahetupaccayā,
patthana16.95:5.1: ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava (anulomamātikā kātabbā) avigate nava. NĪVARAṆO-CEVA-NĪVARAṆASAMPAYUTTA-DUKAṂ niṭṭhitaṃ. Nīvaraṇavippayuttanīvaraṇiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇavippayuttanīvaraṇiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nīvaraṇavippayuttanīvaraṇiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . (paṭisandhi, saṃkhittaṃ.
patthana16.95:6.1: Yathā cūḷantaraduke lokiyadukaṃ evaṃ kātabbaṃ. Ninnānākaraṇaṃ). NĪVARAṆAVIPPAYUTTA-NĪVARAṆIYA-DUKAṂ niṭṭhitaṃ. 2. Parāmāsaṃ
